name: Ultra-power blast
description: The ultra-power blast was a modification that allowed laser cannons to release their entire energy stores in one shot, thus creating a boosted energy bolt. It was installed by the Rebel Alliance on the modified TIE/LN starfighters of Flying Bantha Squadron.

data.name: Ultra-power blast
data.capacity: 6 shots at standard strength, followed by 1 boosted energy bolt
